summary: Sasol Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, a routine report of material information by a foreign private issuer under the 1934 Act. The filing consists primarily of image data (encoded ASCII art of a .jpg file) and provides no substantive textual disclosure of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or similar corporate event. As a foreign issuer's current report on Form 6-K, this is an ordinary periodic filing equivalent to a Form 8-K for domestic companies. No deal terms, structural changes, or event-driven catalysts are described.
